lena-fin: Heads up 8:30 AM batch	
Charge run for NexaMed (single $18,450 invoice) failed: two corporate cards attempted, both returned processor code `CARD_REJECT_51` (do not honor). Need immediate triage: retries, customer outreach, and possibility of splitting payment or short terms.

omar-payments: Can you post last4 and whether tokens are same issuer?

lena-fin: last4: 4556, 2233. Different tokens, both on BIN range for same bank. IDs: pay_nx1..., pay_nx2... (DMing).

billing-bot: [system] payment.failed events=2 reason=card_decline code=CARD_REJECT_51.

sylvie-support: Customer (acct:nexamedsys) opened ticket asking "Will this block our service?" We should avoid alarming language and offer clear next steps.

omar-payments: Plan suggestion: 1) Immediately pause automated retries; 2) Offer an invoice split: accept ACH for majority and capture smaller amount by card (e.g., 10% to keep service active) if they approve; 3) Offer one-time Net-15 with no late fee pending ACH clearance; 4) If they confirm ACH, cancel card retries and send secure ACH intake link.

lena-fin: That split option could work — customer had asked about keeping service active during payment. Draft message:

Hi NexaMed 1) We attempted your scheduled charge but the issuing bank declined the cards; no funds were captured. 2) To avoid service interruption we can: a) send an ACH link to pay the full invoice, or b) if better, collect a 10% card authorization now and accept the remaining balance via ACH (microdeposit) within 15 days. 3) If you prefer, we can place this invoice on a one-time 15-day term while payment is arranged. Please reply with preferred option and we'll proceed.

Redwood Billing

Note: keep wording neutral per legal.

tara-legal: Approve wording but do not call out "decline" as fraud. Use "issuing bank declined". Any credit commitments must be recorded in Zendesk and ops metadata.

raj-ops: Approving one-time Net-15 up to $20k for NexaMed. Set account metadata temp_terms=net15_20k and add ops_reminder=day12. I'll also approve a 10% authorization via card as temporary hold.

omar-payments: I'll pause retries and prepare a command to do a 10% auth for the smaller token if customer agrees. Command (internal): /payments auth --payment-id pay_nx1... --amount 1845 --hold=true --expires 5d --note "partial auth to prevent disruption"

sylvie-support: Sending message in ticket #5012 asking preference and linking secure ACH intake. Customer replied: "Do the 10% hold and send ACH link. We'll clear ACH within a week." :white_check_mark:

omar-payments: Proceeding: cancel scheduled retries, initiate partial auth on pay_nx1..., mark other token awaiting ACH. Creating invoice link and ACH intake (secure).

billing-bot: [system] invoice.link created https://redwood-invoices/local/ln_nexa-5012 (expires 7d). microdeposit.initiated acct=nexa status=pending verify_url=https://redwood-payments/verify/nexa (expires 7d). partial.auth created auth_9f3b status=held amount=1845 expires_in=5d

lena-fin: Billing note added: "Temp net15_20k approved by raj-ops; partial auth 10% held; invoice link + ACH started; retries paused."

tara-legal: Reminder: do not post PANs or auth codes in Slack. Store only status flags in Zendesk.

raj-ops: Good job. I'll review account on day 12 and release hold if ACH clears earlier.

sylvie-support: Ticket updated and customer confirms the plan. Closing thread here  status: partial auth placed, ACH flow initiated, retries stopped, net-15 applied. Will reconcile when ACH clears or card auth captures.
